anchor.quote: Here $h$ is the number of elements of the ground set.
Write $T$ for the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$.
The intersection of two sets is the set of elements they have in common, so $\{1,2,3\}\cap\{1,2,4\}=\{1,2\}$.
